title: Voltrix V2 datasheet (2026 pricing)
text: Voltrix V2 autonomous mobile robot. Navigation: LiDAR plus vision. Runtime: 10 hours. The Voltrix V2 list price is $38,500 with a 600 kg payload capacity. Fleet-software licence is sold separately. Prices exclude installation.

facts.statement: The Voltrix V2 list price is $38,500 with a 600 kg payload capacity.
